episodes.h1: Aranpreet on beauty, social media and building By Aran
episodes.seo_title: Aranpreet on beauty, social media and building By Aran | The Inner Circle Podcast Ep 15
episodes.meta: Beauty creator and entrepreneur Aranpreet talks to DJ Haashim about building a personal brand, the pressures of social media and launching her new business By Aran. Episode 15 of The Inner Circle Podcast.
summary: In episode 15, DJ Haashim sits down with Aranpreet, known online as Beauty With Aranpreet, for an open conversation about her journey through the beauty industry, building her presence on social media and stepping into a new chapter with her own venture, By Aran.

Aranpreet talks about what it has taken to build a personal brand from scratch: the consistency it demands, the pressures that come with living part of your life in public, and how she developed the confidence to call herself an entrepreneur rather than just a creator. She is candid about the gap between how a business looks on Instagram and what it takes behind the scenes to turn an idea into something real.

The conversation also gets into the reality of building something of your own. The lessons learned along the way, the moments of doubt, and what keeps Aranpreet motivated to keep growing and evolving when the easy option would be to stand still.
If you work in beauty, create content, or are thinking about turning a following into a business, this is an honest look at how one person is doing exactly that.
points: Aranpreet's journey through the beauty industry
Building a personal brand on social media
Dealing with the pressure that comes with a public profile
Finding confidence as an entrepreneur
Turning an idea into a real business with By Aran
The lessons behind building something of your own
What keeps her motivated to keep growing
episodes.about: Aranpreet is a beauty creator and entrepreneur, known on Instagram as Beauty With Aranpreet, and the founder of By Aran.

episodes.h1: Niharica Raizada: from medicine to Bollywood
episodes.seo_title: Niharica Raizada interview: from medicine to Bollywood | The Inner Circle Podcast Ep 14
episodes.meta: Actress, producer and former Miss India UK Niharica Raizada on breaking into Bollywood, rejection and resilience, and the legacy of her grandfather O. P. Nayyar. Episode 14 of The Inner Circle Podcast.
summary: The Inner Circle welcomes Niharica Raizada: international actress, producer, former Miss India UK, and a woman whose path has taken her from medicine and academia into Bollywood and international cinema.

Known for appearances in films including Sooryavanshi, IB71, Total Dhamaal and Masaan, Niharica has built a career that crosses cultures, industries and expectations. She is also the granddaughter of the legendary Indian music composer O. P. Nayyar, which gives her a personal connection to one of the most celebrated eras of Indian music.

In this episode, DJ Haashim talks to Niharica about growing up internationally and finding her identity, the decision to leave medicine for acting, becoming Miss India UK, and what it actually took to break into Bollywood. She speaks openly about the reality behind the glamour: the rejection, the pressure, the perseverance, and what it is like to work alongside some of the biggest names in Indian cinema.
It is a conversation about the person behind the films and the public image: the ambition, the sacrifices and the experiences that have shaped her, and what she wants to achieve next.
points: Growing up internationally and finding her identity
Her journey from medicine to acting
Becoming Miss India UK
Breaking into Bollywood
Working on major Indian film productions
The reality of being an actress behind the scenes
Rejection, pressure and perseverance
Working alongside some of Bollywood's biggest names
Her grandfather O. P. Nayyar's musical legacy
Building a career across India and internationally
What's next for Niharica Raizada
episodes.about: Niharica Raizada is an international actress, producer and former Miss India UK, with film credits including Sooryavanshi, IB71, Total Dhamaal and Masaan. She is the granddaughter of composer O. P. Nayyar.

episodes.h1: The Jung Brothers on South Asians in football, family and legacy
episodes.seo_title: The Jung Brothers: South Asians in football | The Inner Circle Podcast Ep 13
episodes.meta: Arjun and Karun Jung talk to DJ Haashim about their football journeys, South Asian representation in the game, grassroots development and the work of Sporttiers. Episode 13 of The Inner Circle Podcast.
summary: In episode 13, DJ Haashim sits down with brothers Arjun Jung and Karun Jung for a conversation about football, family, representation and creating opportunities for the next generation.

Arjun and Karun share their individual journeys through the game, the work being done through Sporttiers, and their passion for helping more young people, particularly those from South Asian backgrounds, believe there is a place for them in football.

The conversation gets into the realities of South Asian representation in the sport: why so few players reach the professional game, the barriers young players can face, the importance of coaching and grassroots development, and what parents can do to support children who want to pursue football seriously.

The brothers also open up about growing up together, the competition between them, family values, setbacks, discipline, and the legacy they want to leave behind. As they put it, this conversation is bigger than football. It is about representation, opportunity and showing the next generation what is possible.

Growing up as the Jung brothers
South Asian representation in football
Why so few South Asians reach the professional game
Breaking stereotypes and cultural barriers
Grassroots football and youth development
Karun's work with Sporttiers
The role of parents in youth football
Talent versus discipline
Brotherhood, family and legacy
episodes.about: Arjun Jung and Karun Jung are brothers with backgrounds in football. Karun works with Sporttiers, supporting young players and grassroots development.
